title: Tom Holland speaks about the new Spider-Man movie – level 3
paragraphs: The upcoming film Spider-Man: Brand New Day, which will be released on July 31, takes place years after Doctor Strange erased everyone’s memories of Peter Parker.

Star Tom Holland described the story as grittier, more emotional, centered on vulnerability, and warning against the dangers of living in isolation. Although Peter loses his connection to loved ones like MJ and Ned, he forms an unexpected alliance with the vigilante The Punisher, played by Jon Bernthal. The movie also features appearances from other prominent Marvel characters, including Yelena Belova and Bruce Banner.

While speculation surrounds the secret role of actress Sadie Sink, director Destin Daniel Cretton urged fans not to overanalyze rumors so they can enjoy the surprises in theaters. Overall, the film balances humor and action, and explores the brave step of asking for help when facing hardship.
